title: Camcorder on-screen display
description: Draw the camcorder viewfinder overlay - REC dot, tape speed, battery, tape counter, and the time and date stamp in a blocky character-generator font with a black outline - so it is baked into every photo.

clauses.text: The date and time read like a 90s US camcorder stamp, e.g. 'OCT.12 2026' and '10:48:03 PM', and the tape counter reads like '0:12:34'.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "stamps are formatted like a camcorder" passes

clauses.text: Text is drawn from a real 5x7 character-generator font with a black outline, so it stays readable on any background, and every character the overlay uses has a glyph.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "text is outlined block glyphs" passes

clauses.text: The overlay puts REC with a red dot top-left and the date bottom-right, and can be told to use only given colours so dithered photos stay pure.
clauses.observable_by: tests named "overlay elements land in their corners" and "overlay can be restricted to palette colours" pass

clauses.text: Drawing into a frame too small to hold the overlay clips instead of crashing.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "overlay clips in tiny frames" passes

cases.description: fixed date/time and counter values give exact strings, including single-digit days and midnight/noon
every overlay character has a non-empty glyph except space; a drawn letter has white pixels each touching black outline
red pixels only top-left, date-stamp pixels in the bottom-right quadrant
with a palette given, every overlay pixel is a palette colour
